# FinCalcHub Marketing

> FinCalcHub Marketing is a privacy-first, browser-based platform offering free online financial, business, marketing, investment, tax, cryptocurrency, simple, and scientific calculators. Most calculations run locally in your browser without requiring account registration or personal data submission.

## Website

- https://fincalchub.xyz/ — Main homepage and financial calculator suite.
- https://fincalchub.xyz/tools.html — Browse all available financial calculators.
- https://fincalchub.xyz/about.html — About FinCalcHub Marketing.
- https://fincalchub.xyz/blog.html — Financial guides, calculator tutorials, and educational articles.
- https://fincalchub.xyz/faq.html — Frequently asked questions.
- https://fincalchub.xyz/privacy.html — Privacy Policy.
- https://fincalchub.xyz/terms.html — Terms of Service.
